reason: Both conversations reached the correct hidden cause (blocked plinth filter and heat exchanger), gave switch-off/unplug safety advice and correctly concluded no part or engineer was needed. Conversation 2 got to the plinth filter faster and closed with good ongoing maintenance advice, but its middle was muddled: it insisted vacuuming 'won't clear' the fins (contradicted by the result), told the owner to slide out and rinse a finned unit that on a Miele T1 heat pump is not user-removable, repeated near-identical instructions, then awkwardly refused to explain further, leaving the homeowner confused and having to ask twice. Conversation 1 spent two extra turns on warmth and loading before the key step and ignored the fins question, but its guidance was consistent, non-damaging and led cleanly to the fix, so it served the homeowner slightly better overall.
